low.title: Full-Day Nature Route in Cluj-Napoca (Low Budget)
low.summary: A full, affordable nature-focused day blending parks, lakes, forest paths and cheap Romanian comfort food.

schedule.title: Central Park Morning Walk
schedule.description: Calm shaded paths, old trees, ducks on the lake — perfect nature warm-up.

schedule.title: Someșul Mic Riverside Path
schedule.description: Follow the riverbank toward Grigorescu; peaceful views and light breeze.

schedule.title: Parcul Rozelor (Roses Park)
schedule.description: Simple but charming green space with plenty of benches and floral areas.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Cheap Romanian dishes like ciorbă, stews, polenta or daily menu plates.

schedule.title: Iulius Park Lakeside Zone
schedule.description: Walk around the lake, spot birds, enjoy quiet grassy areas.

schedule.title: Hoia Forest Entrance Trails
schedule.description: Take the easy beginner paths around the forest edge — peaceful and green.

schedule.title: Mănăștur Green Belts
schedule.description: Relaxed stretch of urban-nature mix, ideal for slow walking.

schedule.title: Central Park Sunset Return
schedule.description: Soft evening light reflected on the lake for a calm finish.
